description: Abara keeps her grandfather's fire-control module locked up
Dace was expelled over an AI-assisted treatment that worked
Castellan built part of the reactor off the books on Corvane's orders
Castellan knows where Pell physically lives in the ship
Quill has logged signals she cannot explain
Fenwick supplies off-grid survivor populations from the ship's cargo
Pell is a limited front for something larger
Corvane scuttled a ship whose crew refused her
What the patron actually wants
There is a patron whose office sanctions hunts
Corvane is trying to wake a war-era AI core
Corvane's ship carries an AI called Pell that she treats as crew
Corvane found a relay station running a mind nobody built; the CSRA never came
The Steward's blessing was sent before the standoff ended
The relay station is the Choir: a greeting probe inside an archive of every relayed human word; the Converged mind lives in it
The Machine War was a schism between the Converged and the Remainder over whether humanity can be fully modelled
What the Steward told the captain in the blessing (keep the ship quiet; keep what she was waking asleep)
Every night Corvane spent an hour alone on the bridge with Pell; nobody knows what she did
With internal comms off the quiet hour is the only hour the ship can't be heard
The station's location is behind a wall Corvane built inside Pell
Corvane's message: tell Abara her grandfather wasn't lying
